sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:56070 
Court No. - 12

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 8748 of 2024
Applicant :- Hanuman Nishad
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Lko.
And 3 Others

Counsel for Applicant :- Nijam Ahamad
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
Despite service of notice, no one appeared on behalf of the complainant.
2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.195 of 2024, under Sections 363, 376-D IPC and Section 5/6 of POCSO Act, Police Station Raje Sultanpur, District Ambedkar Nagar.

3. In terms of the FIR in question, it was alleged that on 22.06.2024 at about 10:00 PM, in the night,
the daughter of the informant went missing and on 23.06.2024 at about 8:00 PM, she came back and informed that the applicant and the other co-accused had enticed her and wrong was committed Hanuman Nishad vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Lko.

1 on her.
The age of the victim is disclosed as 15 years.

In the statement under Section 161 of Cr.P.C.,
the victim stated that she met the applicant around 15 days ago and both of them were on talking term.
Subsequently, on calling of the applicant, the victim had gone and wrong was committed and thereafter, the victim was dropped in the same night at about 2:00 PM, night.

In the statement under Section 164 of Cr.P.C., the victim stated that both the accused had taken her on a bike and the applicant had committed wrong on her and thereafter dropped her at 2:00 PM, night.
The medical on record does not corroborate the allegations as levelled.
The tentative age of the victim is around 16-17 years.
4. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

5. Considering the inherent conflict in the statements under Sections 161 and 164 of Cr.P.C. and the version stated in the FIR coupled with the fact that the FIR was lodged after substantial delay, the applicant has no criminal antecedents and is languishing in jail since 06.07.2024
, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Hanuman Nishad be released on bail in the aforesaid first information report on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 14.8.2024 akverma  Hanuman Nishad vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Lko.
